title: Chyll in Jibhi Mountain: A 2N3D Couple Jibhi Tour Package
summary: A calm 2 night 3 day jibhi tour package for couples, with a Jalori Pass trek to Raghupur Fort, riverside stays and all meals included.
body_markdown:
Jibhi does not announce itself. There is no big viewpoint at the entrance, no crowd of day trippers, just wooden homes along a stream and forest closing in on both sides of the road. That quiet is the whole point, and it is what makes this corner of Kullu district suit couples who want time together rather than a packed sightseeing list.


## **What This Couple Escape Is Built Around**


This is a slow, two night stay in the Banjar valley, framed as a jibhi tour package for two. It pairs riverside nights with one proper mountain day, a short forest trek and meals rooted in local Himachali cooking, so the trip stays restful without feeling empty.


Everything is arranged as one booking, from the overnight bus out of Delhi to the cabs, the stay and the guide. You can see the current couple options and raise a plan on the[Chyll by zing package and enquiry page](https://www.zingbus.com/tour-packages) , with the full range and booking held on the zingbus app.


# **Chyll in Jibhi Mountain: A Couple Jibhi Tour Package in Full**


This 2 Night 3 Day trip is the couple version of the Soulful Jibhi Escape, a jibhi tour package that keeps the pace gentle on purpose. You spend both nights at the same riverside stay in Jibhi, take one guided trek to Raghupur Fort, and close with an easy waterfall walk before the drive back. Here is exactly what the itinerary holds, day by day, along with the stays, the food and the practical details.


## **Why Jibhi Suits a Slow Couples Trip**


Jibhi sits in the Banjar side of Kullu district, at roughly 1,600 metres, in a valley of deodar forest and small streams. The village is known for traditional Himachali wooden houses and a stream spot locals call Mini Thailand, where clear water runs over pale rock. The Balu Nag temple anchors the older part of the settlement.


What makes it work for two people is the lack of pressure. There is no long list of sights you must rush through, so the days leave room to sit by the river, walk a forest trail and eat slowly. The one big outing, the climb above Jalori Pass, gives the trip a clear highlight without turning it into a marathon.


## **What the Chyll in Jibhi Mountain Package Includes**


The package covers four core things: the zingbus journey from Delhi Kashmere Gate to the Aut hub and back, all local transfers in partnered cabs, a trip guide throughout, and the stay in Jibhi, listed as a river view property. Meals across the trip are part of the plan, so breakfast, lunch and dinner are handled.


Because this is a couple itinerary, the rooms are set up on twin sharing. That is worth noting, since the family versions of Jibhi trips open up to triple and quad sharing, while the couple stay keeps to twin only. The trip is built for two people travelling together, not a larger group.


## **How the Two Nights and Three Days Unfold**


The rhythm moves from an overnight bus, into a full valley day, and out through a gentle final morning. Each day is light enough to enjoy at a relaxed pace.


### **Day 0, Delhi to the Mountains**


You board the zingbus from Delhi Kashmere Gate in the evening, with dinner served onboard, and travel through the night towards Aut. This overnight leg is what lets the trip start properly the next morning without losing a daytime to the road.


### **Day 1, Jibhi, Mini Thailand and Waterfalls**


Breakfast is served on the bus as you near Aut, and a partnered cab carries you up to Jibhi. After check in, the day is easy: the Balu Nag temple, the clear pools at Mini Thailand, lunch at a nearby cafe, then the Jibhi Waterfall and the small market. The evening settles into a bonfire and dinner at the stay.


### **Day 2, Jalori Pass and Raghupur Fort**


This is the trip’s main day. A drive takes you up to Jalori Pass, from where a guided three kilometre trek climbs through pine forest and alpine meadow to Raghupur Fort. Lunch comes with a wide Himalayan view, followed by a canvas painting session. You return to Jibhi for another bonfire and dinner, since this couple trip does not camp overnight at the fort.


### **Day 3, Bathad Village and the Journey Home**


After breakfast and checkout, the last outing is a short nature trail to Bathad Waterfall, with time to sit by the stream. A farm to table Himachali lunch closes the trip before the transfer back to Aut and the overnight zingbus to Delhi, with dinner served onboard.


## **Where You Stay in Jibhi**


The stay is a riverside property, and two are named in the plan: Sunshine Cafe and Cottage Riverside, rated 4.7 out of 5, a cottage style stay with river views, hot water and in house dining, and Bleeblu Stays, also rated 4.7 out of 5, with mountain views, hot water and in house dining. Both are set up on twin sharing for couples.


One practical note applies here. The final stay is allocated based on availability, at one of these listed properties or a similarly rated property in Jibhi with comparable amenities. Early check in is also subject to availability, which matters if your bus reaches Aut early and you are hoping to settle in before the day begins.


## **The Jalori Pass and Raghupur Fort Trek**


The trek is the fact worth planning around. Jalori Pass sits at roughly 3,135 metres, and Raghupur Fort is a climb of about three kilometres from the pass, ending at a ruined hill fort with long views across the ranges. It is graded easy to moderate, but it is still a real walk at altitude, not a stroll.


Two things help. Carry a valid government photo ID for the trip, and tell the team in advance about any medical condition before the trek, since the route climbs steadily. Footing on the meadow can be soft after rain, so shoes with grip make the difference between enjoying the top and watching your step the whole way.


## **Food on the Trip**


Meals are included across the itinerary, and they lean local rather than generic. Expect Himachali cooking, including Siddu, a steamed bread served warm, and a farm to table lunch on the final day. Breakfast, lunch and dinner are covered through the trip, alongside the onboard dinners on the bus legs.


It is worth being clear that these meals are part of the tour plan itself. They are not the same as the Food on Bus service you might add to a regular zingbus ticket, which is a separate, route based meal option. On this trip, the food is simply built into the days.


## **Best Time to Plan This Trip**


The trek shapes the season. The road over Jalori Pass generally opens from around mid June and stays reliable through to mid October, and it can close once snow sets in at the higher reaches. A trip planned for late June through September usually gets the fort walk in good condition.


Winter turns the pass uncertain, with snow and possible closures, which can change the Day 2 plan. The monsoon months bring heavy rain to this belt, so trails get slick and roads can slow. If the trek is the reason you are going, the open pass window is the safest bet, and it is worth confirming current conditions close to your dates.


## **What Is Included and What Is Not**


To keep expectations accurate, the included side is the return zingbus travel from Delhi Kashmere Gate to Aut, all local cab transfers, the trip guide, the Jibhi stay and the meals set out in the itinerary. Anything named in the day plan, from the guided trek to the canvas session, is part of the trip.


The standard exclusions apply. These are the 5% GST, any extra food, snacks, tea, coffee or beverages beyond the mentioned meals, anything not specifically listed in the inclusions, and any added cost from unforeseen situations such as weather, roadblocks, landslides or snowfall. On cancellations, more than 15 days before departure is a full refund, 7 to 15 days before is a 50% refund, and within 7 days is non refundable.


## **How to Plan and Book**


Package pricing for this jibhi tour package is not published here, and the current fare sits with the live listing rather than a blog. The practical route is to open the zingbus app, where the full set of couple trips and the booking flow live, since not every option appears on the website.


If your dates or group do not fit a fixed plan, the custom trip enquiry is the way to shape something closer to what you want. You can start that from the same Chyll by zing planner, choosing the destination, the vibe and the stay style, and the team works out the rest from there.


## **A Quiet Escape Worth the Slow Pace**


This trip is not trying to show you everything in Himachal. It picks one valley, gives you two easy nights and one memorable climb, and lets the rest of the time stay unhurried. For couples, that restraint is the appeal, since the point is time together rather than a checklist.


If that sounds right, plan around the open pass season, pack for cool mountain evenings, and let the itinerary carry the logistics. The stay, the cabs, the guide and the meals are arranged, which leaves you free to actually be on the trip rather than managing it.


## **Planning Your Jibhi Trip: Common Questions**


A few practical questions come up often when couples look at this trip, and the answers below cover them.


### **What does this jibhi tour package include for couples?**


This jibhi tour package includes return zingbus travel from Delhi, all local cab transfers, a trip guide, a riverside Jibhi stay on twin sharing, and the meals listed in the itinerary.


### **How long is the Chyll in Jibhi Mountain couple trip?**


The Chyll in Jibhi Mountain couple trip runs for 2 nights and 3 days, starting with an overnight bus from Delhi and ending with an overnight bus back.


### **Does this couple package include overnight fort camping?**


No, this couple trip returns to the Jibhi stay both nights. It does not camp overnight at Raghupur Fort, which is a feature of a different Jibhi itinerary.


### **How hard is the Raghupur Fort trek?**


The Raghupur Fort trek is about three kilometres from Jalori Pass and graded easy to moderate. It climbs at altitude, so a basic level of fitness helps a lot.


### **What kind of stay is included in Jibhi?**


The stay is a riverside property in Jibhi on twin sharing, such as Sunshine Cafe and Cottage Riverside or Bleeblu Stays. The final allocation depends on availability.


### **Are meals included on this trip?**


Yes, breakfast, lunch and dinner are included across the itinerary, along with dinner on the overnight bus legs. The meals are part of the trip, not a separate add on.


### **What is the best time to book this Jibhi trip?**


The best window is roughly mid June to mid October, when the road over Jalori Pass is open. Winter snow and the monsoon can affect the trek and the drive.


### **Where does the trip start and end?**


The trip starts and ends at Delhi Kashmere Gate. The overnight zingbus runs to the Aut hub, and partnered cabs cover the final stretch up to Jibhi and back.


### **Is the package suitable for a honeymoon?**


The trip suits couples who want a quiet mountain escape rather than a busy resort holiday. Twin sharing stays, riverside evenings and one scenic trek shape the experience.


### **How do I book or customise the trip?**


Booking and the full couple range sit on the zingbus app. For different dates or a tailored plan, use the custom trip enquiry on the Chyll by zing planner.


### **What should couples pack for this trip?**


Pack layers for cold mountain nights, trekking shoes with grip for the fort walk, a light rain layer, a valid government photo ID and any personal medication you need.


### **Is there a refund if I cancel?**


Cancelling more than 15 days before departure gives a full refund, 7 to 15 days before gives a 50% refund, and cancelling within 7 days is non refundable.
